name: Illinois
modelFitReason: Flat wage tax with a single rate and exemption allowance fits the calculator model.
localTaxNote: Illinois does not levy a local income tax on wages. City or county charges, if any, are separate from this state estimate.

notes.text: Illinois taxes income at a flat 4.95% rate, effective January 1, 2026.
The Illinois exemption allowance is $2,925 per person for 2026. Illinois has no standard deduction.

Head of household uses the same flat 4.95% rate. This page applies the single-person exemption allowance of $2,925 for that status unless Illinois publishes a different HoH allowance for the tax year.
